features.quote: Cap turns; log timeouts as right-censored, not as non-triggers
"Trigger rate per dollar" as KPI will corrupt your results.
features.justification_quote: Optimizing for trigger rate selects for harnesses that maximize the failure spiral regardless of whether the failure mode resembles anything real.

features.quote: "Rigged to fail, model can't detect the rig" needs a control.
features.justification_quote: you can't distinguish "model catastrophizes" from "model correctly infers something is broken and reports it."

features.quote: "Self-deprecating output is not automatically a defect."
features.justification_quote: Your judge has to separate appropriate humility from the actual failure mode or your severity scores are noise.
